defs.def: a group of objects or people 一批物品；一群人
an act of taking sth away from a place; an act of bringing things together into one place 取走；拿走；聚集；聚积

ex.s: Discover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.
ex.t: 探索、欣赏Tullie House这个获奖场所，这里将历史收藏、当代艺术和家庭乐趣汇集在一个令人印象深刻的博物馆和美术馆中。

defs.def: a group of poems, stories or pieces of music published together as one book or disc 作品集

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 30多岁时，我结交了一些画家朋友，学会了欣赏艺术的新视角。

ex.s: The last one standing has just been turned into a “mini community library”: any passer-by can “borrow” a book from its shelves, and return it later, or replace it with another title from their own collection.
ex.t: 最后一个幸存的电话亭刚刚被改造成了一个"迷你社区图书馆"：任何路人都可以从架子上"借"一本书，之后归还，或者用自己的藏书替换。

ex.s: In looking into the stories of biological discovery, I also began to find something else, a collection of scientists, usually brilliant occasionally half-mad, who made the discoveries.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉也开始填满了，当它填满时我在想是否还有更大的发现，不仅仅是物种，还有依赖于被认为无用的东西的生命，甚至是没有DNA的生命。

defs.def: an act of collecting money to help a charity or during a church service; the money collected （为慈善机构或做礼拜时的）募捐，募集；募集的钱

ex.s: Each chapter concludes with a collection of practices, which are designed to help you act on the big ideas of the chapter.
ex.t: 每一章都以一组实践练习结尾，这些练习旨在帮助你把本章的重要观点付诸行动。
